data.title: 红莲 · 竹林私汤的月下舒展
data.description: 幽静竹林掩映的私人露天温泉，夜空悬挂着一轮皎洁明月。红莲倚靠在光滑的池边青石上，清澈泉水没至胸际。雪白的长发浸润在温热泉水中如丝散开，水珠滑过她泛红的光洁脊背，她侧眸回望，冷冽的剑气在升腾的热气中化作脉脉深情。
data.location: secluded outdoor natural hot spring surrounded by bamboo and night mist
data.action: 倚靠在光滑的池边青石上，清澈泉水没至胸际，雪白的长发浸润在温热泉水中如丝散开
data.lighting: cool blue moonlight blending with warm submerged stone lights and mist
data.camera: from behind, three quarter view, cowboy shot
data.promptProse: In a secluded outdoor hot spring bordered by bamboo groves under a bright full moon, Scarlet leans against the smooth dark stone ledge with her long wet hair trailing across the warm water. She turns over her shoulder with a soft, unguarded gaze through the rising mist.
data.animaCaption: Resting nude against the mossy stone rim of the bamboo-ringed hot spring with water up to her chest, she glances back over her bare wet shoulder with flushed cheeks as her damp hair drifts across the moonlit surface.
data.nsfwProse: Completely unclothed in the steaming spring with water reaching her chest, droplets glisten down her bare back, shoulders, and curved side.
